description: This file defines the interface for OCIContainer management within the WPEFramework, including container states, notifications, and control methods such as start, stop, pause, resume, and execute commands.

classes.name: IOCIContainer
classes.description: Interface for managing OCI containers, including container lifecycle and notification handling.

classes.name: IOCIContainer::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for container events such as start, stop, failure, and state change.

methods.description: Get detailed information about a specific container.

methods.description: Get current state of a specific container.

methods.name: StartContainer
methods.description: Start a container from a bundle.

methods.name: StartContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Start a container from a Dobby specification.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Execute a command inside a container.
